name: @postern/daemon
description: Local backend service. Runs the protocol, storage, and AI layers and exposes them to the UI over a loopback HTTP API. Bundled as a Tauri sidecar.

scripts.build: esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --target=node22 --packages=bundle --external:jsdom --external:@libsql/client --outfile=dist/daemon.cjs && rm -rf dist/migrations && cp -R ../../packages/storage/drizzle dist/migrations
